items.title: Solid–vapor synthesis of dynamic crystalline one-dimensional supramolecular polymers from amorphous macrocycles
items.reason: The publisher listing confirms a new solid–vapor host–guest synthesis of a dynamic crystalline supramolecular polymer, but the accessible evidence does not show monomer/host–guest breadth or whether the method is transferable beyond one material system.
items.evidenceBasis: The fresh compact has no abstract. A same-day Nature Communications research listing describes a highly dynamic crystalline supramolecular polymer made by a unique solid–vapor host–guest-driven synthesis. That establishes more than a title keyword, but not the article-specific generality required to decide whether this is in-scope polymer synthesis methodology or target-specific responsive-material assembly.
items.challengeReason: It cannot be excluded merely as a material because polymer assembly is the principal synthetic act, and true polymer/architecture-control methods may qualify. It also cannot be included from one publisher teaser without preparative breadth. Both passes therefore defer this DOI only.
items.evidenceNeeded: Full publisher abstract or body/SI showing macrocycle/guest variation, reproducible solid–vapor assembly scope, and whether the synthesis controls a transferable chain/architecture feature rather than one target material.
items.nextAction: Use the existing browser/VPN evidence path to read the article abstract or relevant preparation section; do not infer generality from the listing teaser.

items.title: Electrocatalytic Carbon Dioxide Reduction Coupled with Alcohol Oxidation
topics: Renewable Energy, Sustainability and the Environment
items.reason: Paired electrolysis may represent genuine organic electrosynthesis, but the obtained evidence still does not resolve the preparative contribution.
items.evidenceBasis: The fresh 17:13 compact still contains no abstract. The earlier publisher article/abstract/TOC attempts were bot-blocked, while a search excerpt only suggested cathodic CO2 valorization paired with anodic alcohol oxidation; no alcohol-product scope or preparative evidence was obtained.
items.challengeReason: Energy-related indexing is not enough to exclude a possibly genuine paired organic electrosynthesis, while the title and snippet are not enough to include it. The DOI remains individually deferred.
items.evidenceNeeded: Obtain the publisher abstract or relevant text/SI describing the alcohol substrates and oxidation products, the transferable preparative transformation, and scope or isolated-product/route evidence; distinguish this from an electrode/energy-performance-only study.
items.nextAction: Obtain textual publisher abstract or preparative sections showing alcohol substrates, products, scope and isolated/preparative evidence through the existing browser/VPN review path.
